text.p: An earth tremor hit Sarajevo on Thursday afternoon, shaking buildings and causing all telephone lines to go down, witnesses said.
"An earthquake of an unknown strength shook the town," Sarajevo radio reported after the quake hit at 3.25 p.m.
"The house we are in shook for three to four seconds," a Reuter reporter said. Debris was seen falling from buildings in the centre of the town, he added.
The quake was also felt in the northeastern Bosnian town of Tuzla, about 160 km (100 miles) from Sarajevo.
It was not immediately known whether there were any casualties, or how strong the quake was on the open-ended Richter scale.
